categories.title: Family & Home
categories.question: Keeping the house running?
categories.sub: The sitter, the baby, the meds, the groceries, the sound that finally gets everyone to sleep, and one big button on an old tablet for whoever cannot carry a phone. The everyday logistics of the people you love.

categories.title: School
categories.question: Teaching this year?
categories.sub: Plan the whole year once, keep grades on your own computer, and have the sub folder ready before you are sick.

categories.title: Events & Groups
categories.question: Planning a big day?
categories.sub: Weddings, seasons, sign-ups, game nights. One link for everyone instead of a group-chat avalanche.

categories.title: Paper & Files
categories.question: Drowning in paperwork?
categories.sub: Scan it, merge it, sign it, shrink it, all on your device. Nothing gets uploaded and nothing holds your file for ransom.

categories.title: Moving & Travel
categories.question: On the move?
categories.sub: Which box has the can opener, what goes in the suitcase, and photos of everything before the insurance claim needs them.

categories.title: Money
categories.question: Who owes what?
categories.sub: Split the trip, the dinner, the house bills. Fairly, on your device, no accounts. And a screener that says whether the rental actually pays for itself.

categories.title: Body & Mind
categories.question: Working on you?
categories.sub: A to-do list that feels as good as paper to cross off, and a strength app that writes your next workout for you. Small wins, stacked up.

categories.title: Music
categories.question: Learning the neck?
categories.sub: Tap drills, scales in positions, chord charts and rhythm, built by somebody who teaches this for a living. And a little studio for when you want to write something rather than practise it.

categories.title: Night Sky
categories.question: Looking up tonight?
categories.sub: A star atlas you collect from: real planet positions, live NASA data, lessons and citizen science. In testing while it grows.

categories.title: Outdoors
categories.question: Out in the field?
categories.sub: A rockhounding log for every find: photo, GPS and label, all on your device. In testing while it grows.

categories.title: Sports
categories.question: Coaching a team this season?
categories.sub: The baseball rules little leagues skip, on a diamond kids can tap. And a soccer board where the defence reacts instead of standing still, so you find out whether the play actually works.
